\multicolumn{5}{@{}l}{\textbf{docking\_\allowbreak{}node}} \\
\code{control_rate}$^\dagger$ & 20 & Hz & 1..200 & loop rate \\
\code{control_node}$^\dagger$ & \code{control_mux_node} &  &  & mux whose field is checked against the goal ("": no) \\
\code{tag.frame}$^\dagger$ & \code{charging_dock} &  &  & TF frame of the dock tag \\
\code{tag.normal_axis} & \code{z} &  & x, y, z & tag axis along the plate normal (its sign is found) \\
\code{tag.timeout_sec} & 0.5 & s & 0.05..5 & an older detection is not in view \\
\code{tag.max_range} & 4 & m & 0.2..20 & further detections ignored \\
\code{tag.smoothing} & 0.3 &  & 0.01..1 & weight of a new detection in the dock estimate (1: none) \\
\code{tag.max_jump} & 0.25 & m & 0.01..5 & a detection moving the dock further: outlier \\
\code{tag.max_outliers} & 5 &  & 1..100 & this many outliers in a row: start the estimate over \\
\code{goal.distance} & 0.75 & m & 0.05..5 & base\_\allowbreak{}link to the tag along its normal \\
\code{goal.lateral_offset} & 0 & m & -2..2 & goal beside the tag centre (+left facing it) \\
\code{goal.yaw_offset_deg} & 0 & deg & -45..45 & goal heading beside the tag normal \\
\code{goal.direction} & \code{forward} &  & forward, backward & forward: faces the tag; backward: backs in \\
\code{centering.lateral_tolerance} & 0.03 & m & 0.002..0.5 & centred within this beside the line \\
\code{centering.yaw_tolerance_deg} & 2 & deg & 0.1..30 & aligned within this to the line \\
\code{centering.realign_lateral} & 0.1 & m & 0.005..1 & further beside the line: stop and centre \\
\code{centering.realign_yaw_deg} & 8 & deg & 0.5..60 & further off the heading: stop and centre \\
\code{centering.hold_sec} & 0.3 & s & 0..10 & centred this long before walking on \\
\code{centering.timeout_sec} & 30 & s & 1..600 & give up centring (an attempt fails) \\
\code{approach.speed} & 0.12 & m/\allowbreak{}s & 0.01..1 & speed toward the dock \\
\code{approach.min_speed} & 0.03 & m/\allowbreak{}s & 0..0.5 & floor to beat the robot deadband \\
\code{approach.max_lateral_speed} & 0.08 & m/\allowbreak{}s & 0..1 & sideways correction cap (omni) \\
\code{approach.max_yaw_rate} & 0.4 & rad/\allowbreak{}s & 0.01..3 & yaw rate cap \\
\code{approach.kp_distance} & 0.8 & 1/\allowbreak{}s & 0..10 & gain on the distance \\
\code{approach.kp_lateral} & 1.5 & 1/\allowbreak{}s & 0..10 & gain beside the line \\
\code{approach.kp_yaw} & 1.5 & 1/\allowbreak{}s & 0..10 & gain on the heading \\
\code{approach.look_ahead} & 0.3 & m & 0.05..3 & steering look-ahead on the line (diff) \\
\code{approach.blind_distance} & 0.25 & m & 0..3 & this close the dock estimate freezes and the tag may leave the view \\
\code{approach.position_tolerance} & 0.02 & m & 0.002..0.5 & arrived within this of the goal distance \\
\code{approach.timeout_sec} & 60 & s & 1..600 & give up the approach (an attempt fails) \\
\code{settle.time_sec} & 1 & s & 0..30 & stand still this long \\
\code{settle.distance_tolerance} & 0.04 & m & 0.002..0.5 & docked within this along the normal \\
\code{settle.lateral_tolerance} & 0.03 & m & 0.002..0.5 & docked within this beside the line \\
\code{settle.yaw_tolerance_deg} & 4 & deg & 0.1..45 & docked within this heading \\
\code{retry.max_retries} & 2 &  & 0..20 & attempts after the first (0: none) \\
\code{retry.backoff_distance} & 0.4 & m & 0..3 & move this far away from the dock first \\
\code{retry.speed} & 0.1 & m/\allowbreak{}s & 0.01..1 & backing-off speed \\
\code{supervision.search_timeout_sec} & 5 & s & 0.1..600 & no dock tag this long after a start: failed \\
\code{supervision.lost_timeout_sec} & 3 & s & 0.1..60 & tag gone this long beyond blind\_\allowbreak{}distance \\
\code{supervision.pose_timeout_sec}$^\dagger$ & 0.5 & s & 0.05..5 & an older odom pose stops the robot \\
\code{supervision.stall_timeout_sec} & 8 & s & 0.5..120 & commanded but not moving this long: held \\
\code{supervision.stall_distance} & 0.02 & m & 0..1 & moved less than this: not moving \\
\code{supervision.stall_yaw_deg} & 2 & deg & 0..90 & turned less than this: not moving \\
\code{hooks.sit}$^\dagger$ & [] &  &  & called once docked (e.g. /robot/sit) \\
\code{hooks.charge}$^\dagger$ & [] &  &  & called after sitting (e.g. /robot/charge/start) \\
\code{hooks.stop_charge}$^\dagger$ & [] &  &  & called first when undocking (e.g. /robot/charge/stop) \\
\code{hooks.stand}$^\dagger$ & [] &  &  & called before backing off the dock (e.g. /robot/stand) \\
\code{hooks.navigation_stop}$^\dagger$ & \code{navigation/stop} &  &  & stops the path follower when docking starts ("": no) \\
\code{hooks.timeout_sec}$^\dagger$ & 15 & s & 0.1..600 & each hook call times out \\
\code{hooks.sit_settle_sec} & 1.5 & s & 0..60 & wait after sitting before the charge hooks \\
\code{hooks.stand_settle_sec} & 1.5 & s & 0..60 & wait after standing before backing off \\
\code{charge.confirm_timeout_sec} & 30 & s & 0..600 & wait for the battery to charge (0: do not) \\
\code{charge.battery_timeout_sec} & 5 & s & 0.1..120 & an older battery state counts as unknown \\
\code{undock.distance} & 0.5 & m & 0..5 & move this far away from the dock (0: stay) \\
\code{undock.speed} & 0.1 & m/\allowbreak{}s & 0.01..1 & undocking speed \\
\code{undock.timeout_sec} & 30 & s & 1..600 & give up undocking \\
